## The Task

Read the task brief: C:\Users\lutfi\.superpowers\sdd\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts\task-3-brief.md

## The Findings Under Verification

- **Critical** — `BAND_COLOR_GREEN` in `ChartHelpers.bas` (and mirrored in `FCCompletion_All_Modules.txt`) was `5287310`, which does not equal `RGB(146,208,80)` (correct value: `5296274`).
- **Critical** — `BAND_COLOR_PINK` was `13556223`, which does not equal `RGB(255,199,206)` (correct value: `13551615`).
- **Critical** — `BAND_COLOR_ORANGE` was `49152`, which decodes to `RGB(0,192,0)` (a green!), not `RGB(255,192,0)` (correct value: `49407`).
- **Important** — `BAND_COLOR_LTGREEN` was `13561542`, off by 1 in the green channel from `RGB(198,239,206)` (correct value: `13561798`).

(RGB(r,g,b) = r + g*256 + b*65536. The other three constants — DRAFT `15921906`, VOIDED `14277081`, MISSED `10921638` — were already correct and should NOT have changed.)

## The Fix

Read the implementer's report (fix reports are appended at the end): C:\Users\lutfi\.superpowers\sdd\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts\task-3-report.md

**Fix base:** a06e6aa (the head the previous review saw)
**Head:** fdc5edb
**Diff file:** C:\Users\lutfi\.superpowers\sdd\2026-07-30-summary-restructure-and-charts\review-a06e6aa..fdc5edb.diff

Read the diff file once — it contains the fix commit, a stat summary, and the fix diff with surrounding context. Do not re-run git commands beyond what's needed to double check the arithmetic. Your review is read-only on this checkout — do not mutate the working tree, index, HEAD, or branch state.

## Scope

Your scope is the findings list and the fix diff. Verdict every finding. Inspect the fix diff for new problems the fix itself introduced (e.g. did fixing the 4 wrong values accidentally break one of the 3 already-correct ones, or desync the two file copies?). Do NOT re-review code the fix did not touch — the structural/positioning/error-handling aspects of ChartHelpers.bas were already approved in the first review and are out of scope here unless the fix diff touches them.

## Tests

None applicable (VBA, no test runner). Independently recompute all 7 RGB values by hand (R + G*256 + B*65536) against whatever is now in the diff — do not just trust the implementer's claimed verification numbers.

## Output Format

Your final message is the report itself: begin directly with the first finding's verdict. Every line is a verdict, a finding with file:line, or a check you ran — no preamble, no process narration.

### Finding Verdicts

For each of the 4 findings above, in order: ADDRESSED | NOT ADDRESSED, with file:line evidence and the recomputed value.

' Finds the very-hidden ChartData sheet, creating it (as the last sheet in
' the workbook) if it does not yet exist. Safe to call multiple times per
' report run -- every chart-writing routine calls this before writing its
' block.
Public Function EnsureChartDataSheet(wb As Workbook) As Worksheet
    Dim ws As Worksheet
    On Error Resume Next
    Set ws = wb.Sheets(SHEET_CHARTDATA)
    On Error GoTo 0

    If ws Is Nothing Then
        Set ws = wb.Sheets.Add(After:=wb.Sheets(wb.Sheets.Count))
        ws.Name = SHEET_CHARTDATA
    End If

    ws.Visible = xlSheetVeryHidden
    Set EnsureChartDataSheet = ws
End Function

' Creates one chart anchored at anchorCell's top-left corner, sized
' widthPts x heightPts, sourced from srcRange (expected to be a contiguous
' block on the ChartData sheet). seriesColours is a 0-based Variant array of
' RGB Longs (one per series, in SeriesCollection order); pass Empty entries
' to skip colouring a given series (e.g. when a chart type applies its own
' per-point colouring instead). Returns Nothing if anything fails -- callers
' MUST check for Nothing and skip gracefully; a charting failure must never
' abort report generation.
Public Function AddChartFromBlock(targetWs As Worksheet, anchorCell As Range, srcRange As Range, _
        chartType As XlChartType, titleText As String, _
        widthPts As Single, heightPts As Single, _
        seriesColours As Variant, chartName As String) As ChartObject

    On Error GoTo Fail

    Dim co As ChartObject
    Set co = targetWs.ChartObjects.Add(anchorCell.Left, anchorCell.Top, widthPts, heightPts)
    co.Name = chartName

    With co.Chart
        .SetSourceData Source:=srcRange, PlotBy:=xlColumns
        .ChartType = chartType
        .HasTitle = True
        .ChartTitle.Text = titleText

        If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours) Then
            Dim k As Long
            For k = LBound(seriesColours) To UBound(seriesColours)
                If Not IsEmpty(seriesColours(k)) Then
                    On Error Resume Next
                    .SeriesCollection(k - LBound(seriesColours) + 1).Format.Fill.ForeColor.RGB = CLng(seriesColours(k))
                    On Error GoTo Fail
                End If
            Next k
        End If

        If .SeriesCollection.Count > 1 Then
            .HasLegend = True
            .Legend.Position = xlLegendPositionBottom
        Else
            .HasLegend = False
        End If

        .ChartArea.Format.Line.Visible = msoFalse
    End With

    Set AddChartFromBlock = co
    Exit Function

Fail:
    Set AddChartFromBlock = Nothing
End Function
